screening.usefulness_reason: Useful for generic conceptual mathematics: it treats representations, integrable connections, and Higgs bundles as distinct realizations and carefully distinguishes equivalence of categories, analytic isomorphism, topological homeomorphism, and formal local isomorphism rather than collapsing them. It re-encodes Higgs data both as modules over a symmetric algebra and as coherent sheaves on a cotangent bundle, turns integrable connection into infinitesimal transport satisfying a cocycle, uses a scaling action and properness to obtain canonical degenerations, and reduces local deformation singularities through formality to a quadratic cone modulo a stabilizer. Its quotient-space treatment also exposes the difference between raw isomorphism classes, closed orbits, semisimplification, and Jordan equivalence.
